content_zh:
黎语冰并不想花费心思给这个家伙过生日, 本打算折个纸飞机当生日礼物应付她。
不过这天, 他在社区超市看到有卖假蜘蛛的。假蜘蛛是用塑料做的, 有汤碗那么大, 黑乎乎的非常逼真, 看得人头皮发麻。
这么恶心的东西，很适合拿去恶心坏蛋。
于是黎语冰偷偷买了蜘蛛，还多花了两块钱让老板给包上礼品纸。
老板一边包礼品纸一边问：“这是送给谁的礼物呀？”
黎语冰抿了下嘴角, 如实答道：“我同桌。”
“哦，你同桌是男的女的？”
“女的。”
老板把包好的礼物递给他，一脸担忧地提醒道：“小朋友, 你送女孩子这个, 怕是要被打哦。”
黎语冰把生日礼物交给棠雪，棠雪迫不及待地开始拆。
他就在一旁默默地观察她的表情, 期待看到她大惊失色的样子。
棠雪看到蜘蛛后一脸惊奇, 用指尖摸着蜘蛛的后背, 说：“我还以为是真的呢, 吓我一跳。”
吓你一跳……你倒是跳啊……
黎语冰一阵失望, 问她：“你不害怕吗？”
“不怕呀。我妈妈说, 所有的动物都怕人。”
黎语冰感觉棠雪有点可怕。
午饭时，棠雪把大蜘蛛挂在黎语冰的背后，俩人出现在食堂, 吓哭了一整个食堂的小朋友, 还差一点发生踩踏事件。
他们都因此被叫了家长。
黎妈妈听了事情的来龙去脉，觉得特别不可思议。回家的路上，她对黎语冰说：“你是不是傻呀，给女孩子的生日礼物，你送蜘蛛？你这样将来怕是要打一辈子光棍。”
黎语冰心情低落，面无表情地看着车窗外。

在反击棠雪的道路上，他走得太艰辛了。
十一月上旬，棠雪迎来了她最最最喜欢的活动——秋游。
今年他们的秋游地点定在郊区的鹭山。鹭山临着鹭湖公园，是一片小山包，山包上种着很多苹果树，一到秋天，漫山都是彤红的苹果，错错落落，像千盏万盏的小灯笼，特别漂亮。所以当地人又管鹭山叫“苹果山”。
既然去苹果山，那肯定是要围观农民伯伯摘苹果的，而且据说，如果足够听话，他们还有机会亲手摘苹果。
一到鹭山，小孩儿们像出笼的鸟一样叽叽喳喳个不停，赵老师看着骚动的小萝卜头们，警告道：“听我指挥，不要乱跑，山上有老虎，专吃小孩儿……棠雪，你的红领巾是怎么回事？”
棠雪刚才玩红领巾不小心拆开了，再系不回原先的样子，试了几次她就放弃了，就那么随意把红领巾搭在脖子上，像是刚从澡堂子里出来的。
“老师，我不会系。”棠雪说。
赵老师这会儿没时间管她，便指派黎语冰：“黎语冰，你帮棠雪系一下红领巾。”
黎语冰有点不情愿，却只能照做。
他给她系红领巾的时候她摇头晃脑的乱动，黎语冰不耐烦地说：“别动。”
两人离得那么近，棠雪看着黎语冰的脸，他的眼睫毛很长，像两把小扇子，嘴巴紧紧抿着，看起来相当严肃。
“黎语冰，你长得好像我的娃娃。”
“别说话。”
棠雪突然的手痒痒，于是抬手，开始揉黎语冰的脸，左一下右一下，揉一揉捏一捏，像是玩面团一样。
黎语冰皱着眉说，“你别闹了。”
他真是倒了一百辈子的霉，又要给她系红领巾，又要给她玩儿脸。
赵老师带着孩子们步行到一片平坦的地方，这里视野开阔，可以看到鹭湖全貌，是绝佳的午餐地点。
然后她让他们坐下吃午饭。
吃过午餐可以自由活动一会儿，但不许跑太远，绝对不能离开老师的视线。
黎语冰坐在草地上安静地观察着这里的景物，湖光，山色，飞鸟，行船……这次秋游不是白来的，回去要写作文。

庆幸的是，棠雪那个家伙没来烦他，她在和别人追逐打闹。
黎语冰坐了一会儿，突然有人敲他的后背。他扭头，看到棠雪那张眉开眼笑的脸。
“黎语冰，你看这是什么？”棠雪笑眯眯地朝他抖了抖手。
黎语冰目光一偏，看到她右手捏着一条肉虫，肉虫有手指那么长，手指那么粗，豆绿的颜色，背上一串彩色斑点，此时这肉虫被倒提着，正挣扎着扭动肥胖的身躯。
黎语冰脸色一变，起身拔腿就跑。

content_en:
Li Yubing didn't want to spend any time celebrating this guy's birthday. He originally planned to fold a paper airplane as a birthday gift for her.
But that day, he saw fake spiders for sale in the community supermarket. The fake spider was made of plastic and was as big as a soup bowl. It was so black and lifelike that it made people's scalp numb.
Such a disgusting thing is perfect for disgusting bad guys.
So Li Yubing secretly bought the spider and spent an extra two yuan to have the boss wrap it in gift paper.
The boss asked while wrapping the gift paper: "Who is this gift for?"
Li Yubing pursed her lips and replied truthfully: "I'm at the same table."
"Oh, are your tablemates male or female?"
"Female."
The boss handed him the wrapped gift and reminded him with a worried look: "Kid, if you give this to a girl, I'm afraid you'll get beaten."
Li Yubing handed Tang Xue his birthday gift, and Tang Xue couldn't wait to open it.
He silently observed her expression from the side, expecting to see her look shocked.
Tangxue looked surprised when she saw the spider. She touched the spider's back with her fingertips and said, "I thought it was real. It scared me."
I scared you... but you jumped...
Li Yubing felt disappointed and asked her, "Aren't you afraid?"
"Don't be afraid. My mother said that all animals are afraid of people."
Li Yubing felt that Tang Xue was a bit scary.
During lunch, Tangxue hung the big spider on Li Yubing's back. The two appeared in the canteen, scaring the children in the canteen to tears and almost causing a stampede.
They were all called parents because of it.
When Li's mother heard the whole story, she felt very unbelievable. On the way home, she said to Li Yubing: "Are you stupid? You give a girl a spider as a birthday gift? I'm afraid you will be a bachelor for the rest of your life."
Li Yubing was in a depressed mood and looked out the car window expressionlessly.
He had a very hard time fighting back against Tang Xue.
In early November, Tang Xue ushered in her favorite activity - autumn outing.
This year their autumn outing will be in Lushan in the suburbs. Lushan is adjacent to Luhu Park. It is a small hill with many apple trees planted on it. In autumn, the mountain is covered with red apples, scattered here and there, like thousands of small lanterns, which is particularly beautiful. Therefore, the local people call Lushan "Apple Mountain".
If you go to Apple Mountain, you must watch the farmer uncles picking apples, and it is said that if they are obedient enough, they will have the opportunity to pick apples with their own hands.
As soon as we arrived at Lushan, the children were chirping like birds out of a cage. Teacher Zhao looked at the commotion of the little carrots and warned: "Listen to my instructions and don't run around. There are tigers on the mountain that eat children...Tangxue, what's the matter with your red scarf?"
Tangxue was playing with the red scarf and accidentally took it apart. She couldn't tie it back to its original shape. She gave up after trying it a few times and just put the red scarf around her neck casually, as if she had just come out of the bathhouse.
"Teacher, I don't know how to tie." Tang Xue said.
Teacher Zhao had no time to care about her at the moment, so he assigned Li Yubing: "Li Yubing, help Tang Xue tie the red scarf."
Li Yubing was a little reluctant, but he could only do it.
When he tied the red scarf on her, she shook her head and moved around. Li Yubing said impatiently: "Don't move."
The two were so close, Tang Xue looked at Li Yubing's face. His eyelashes were very long, like two small fans, and his mouth was tightly pursed, looking quite serious.
"Li Yubing, you look like my doll."
"Don't talk."
Tangxue's hands suddenly felt itchy, so she raised her hands and began to rub Li Yubing's face, left and right, kneading and kneading, as if playing with dough.
Li Yubing frowned and said, "Stop making trouble."
He was really unlucky for a hundred lifetimes. He wanted to tie her a red scarf and make fun of her face.
Teacher Zhao takes the children for a walkGo to a flat area with a wide view. You can see the entire Heron Lake. It is an excellent lunch spot.
Then she sat them down for lunch.
After lunch, you can move around freely for a while, but you are not allowed to run too far, and you must not leave the teacher's sight.
Li Yubing sat on the grass and quietly observed the scenery here, the lake, the mountains, the birds, the boats... This autumn outing was not in vain, and I had to write a composition when I got back.
Fortunately, that guy Tangxue didn't bother him. She was chasing and messing around with others.
Li Yubing sat for a while, and suddenly someone knocked on his back. He turned his head and saw Tang Xue's cheerful face.
"Li Yubing, what do you think this is?" Tang Xue shook her hand at him with a smile.
Li Yubing looked away and saw a meat worm in her right hand. The worm was as long and as thick as a finger. It was pea green in color and had a series of colorful spots on its back. At this time, the worm was being held upside down and struggling to twist its fat body.
Li Yubing's expression changed, he stood up and ran away.
